{{Top|leg}}
The '''Shovel-handed miners''' were a type of [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] created by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]]. They were first purchased and created to be used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Subterrel/Legends|Subterrel]], known for its vast mining operations. The cloners created the [[Miner/Legends|miners]] sometime between [[4500 BBY]] and [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
